_about: Ascot's main stand, assembled from the modules in assets/models/architecture/stand_modules.json. Order runs LEFT to RIGHT as seen from the track, which at Ascot is EAST (upstream) to WEST (past the post). 'repeat' places the same module that many times in a row. The stand is anchored so the clock tower faces the winning post; its front line is 'setback' metres behind the near (outer) rail of the home straight. Change the list and re-run tools/course/build_ascot_layout.py; the Blender build reads the same list.
